observations: Prediction specifies sorting each word's letters and asks how many bins ten supplied words form.
Silent then listen both mapped to eilnst despite reversed processing order.
Google and gogole both mapped to eggloo, preserving repeated-letter multiplicities.
Completing all words gave groups four, two, three and one; dog alone. Reveal explains exact canonical-key equivalence and contrasts ten key constructions with forty-five pairwise comparisons.

effort: Prediction, reordered first pair, repeated-letter pair, complete grouping, screenshot and reveal.
